combinations.name: Hone Spear on Whetstone
combinations.text: You draw the coastal whetstone steadily along the spearhead until it gleams razor-sharp.

combinations.name: Coat Weapon with Ember Resin
combinations.text: Warm ember resin adheres to your weapon, flickering with bright sparks for your next three strikes!

combinations.name: Press Sunleaf in Field Mortar
combinations.text: You crush the Sunleaf sprig in your mortar and pot a fresh jar of Sunleaf Healing Salve.

combinations.name: Bind Rune Shard to Brass Band
combinations.text: You bind the Sea-Glass Rune Shard into the brass loop, creating an equippable Emerald Wayfarer Amulet.
